reasoning: On the season so far the Nets are the stronger team; with home court the Nets start about 5 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nets win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 213 and 261 total points.
